title: Specter v1
description: The one active Specter of one bot: its accepted profile, its portrait if the user chose one, and the numbers a client needs to change it safely. bindingId is the only reference to the bot, and it is the bot-binding contract's opaque id, never a Crew id. version starts at 1 and rises by one on every accepted change (accept, manual entry, rename, portrait change); a client sends it back as expectedVersion and a mismatch is a 409. portrait is null when the user has chosen none, and the client then draws a placeholder token labelled as such; the embedded portrait always has dataBase64 null. source says where the profile text came from: generated by the summoner, or typed by the user as a manual fallback, which is never presented as AI generation. A rename keeps the source of the text it edits. promptVersion is the fixed prompt version that produced the generated text, or null for manual text. A Specter is cosmetic: nothing here is an agent setting, permission, experience value or level.
